(1) A send to a STOPPED ferret revives it and carries the message as the relaunch's first turn (disposition revived; Ferrets' resume tells the send what it typed through the additive ResumeOptions.onCarried, and the row looks for that pointer and turn, daemon/host.ts reviveLocked). What is not carried is today's durable hold for an explicit revive (queued-for-revive): a relaunch Ferrets refuses, or one that carried nothing, takes the row back and the id starts over, with the refusal's sentence. The tracker's retype of a send whose pane has since gone is refused (no live agent) and settles as today's no-reviver case. (2) The tracker's evidence is the harness plugin's MASKED entries: a send is looked for by its words masked the same way (daemon/host.ts trackedLedger), and the harness's own input-queue records reach it through TranscriptEntry.data for Claude only (claude-code transcript.ts proof entries); Codex records no queue, so a Codex send queued mid-turn is proved by the pane or by the user record at the drain. (3) Claude input evidence without a native UUID is identified by its absolute byte offset; an external rewrite that shifts a previously claimed record can re-offer it and falsely confirm another matching send, an inherited v4 limit that append-style compaction does not trigger.
